effects.description: [Blocker] (After your opponent declares an attack, you may rest this card to make it the new target of the attack.)
steps: (Optional) Rest this card to change the attack target to this Character
notes: You can only use this effect when your opponent declares an attack
You don't have to use this effect — it's your choice
After using this effect, this card becomes rested

effects.description: [On K.O.] If your Leader has the {Red-Haired Pirates} type, K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a base power of 6000 or less.
conditions: Your Leader has the {Red-Haired Pirates} type
Your opponent has at least 1 Character with base power 6000 or less
steps: (Optional) Choose up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with base power 6000 or less
notes: This effect activates automatically when this Character is K.O.'d
You can choose not to use this effect even if there is a valid target
